nodes.label: Domain-Driven Frontend Backend Monorepo
nodes.rationale: A top-level frontend/backend split and backend auth/listings/users domains keep boundaries simple and explicit.

nodes.label: Auth Guard Bottom Sheet
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated Create or Profile taps show a sign-in sheet without navigating away, preserving the user's current context.

nodes.label: Migration 001 Marketplace Schema
nodes.rationale: All four core tables, UUIDs, soft deletion, JSONB, and nullable PostGIS geography are created up front because schema decisions are permanent.

nodes.label: Context-Driven Swappable Theme
nodes.rationale: Typed semantic tokens accessed only through useTheme make dark/light toggles and whole-theme replacement a provider-level change.
